estate_label: Intellectual property, standards, and data-rights estate
why_new_estate: Anduril and other stack-control investigations repeatedly turn on data rights, interfaces, and substitution, while research and capital estates need assignment and licensing chronology.

denominator_contract.unit: one patent family, trademark, assignment, license, standard, contract rights schedule, interface-control document, or technical baseline
denominator_contract.inclusion_rule: Official patent, assignment, trademark, standards, procurement, protest, corporate filing, and contract-rights records.
denominator_contract.exclusion_rule: Patent citations as licenses; marketing use of a standard as compliance; contract award as proof of government data rights.
denominator_contract.time_window: historical through 2026-07-23, with each source query recording its own bounded window
required_null_controls: contract with no located rights schedule

next_acquisition: join inventions, assignments, licenses, standards, contract clauses, interface baselines, and substitution rights
boundaries: A patent, assignment, standard contribution, license, contract clause, and practical control of an interface are different facts. Citation or standards participation does not establish ownership or adoption.
A surveyed and prepared estate is not an acquired, completed, or finding-bearing estate.
Official source availability is not evidence of a subject overlap.
